recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, black-and-white shirtless male portrait set against a gritty, textured background, framed by a vertical burnt-orange sidebar containing layered, industrial, and gothic typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the organic, smooth skin of the subject and the harsh, mechanical texture of the background.
Vertical tension created by the left-aligned color block and stacked text.
Juxtaposition of traditional Blackletter script with modern, monospaced digital numerals.
coreInvariants: Visible halftone or film grain texture
Burnt orange or terracotta accent panel

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned in the right two-thirds of the frame, waist-up, looking directly at the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the vertical orange bar on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move down to the torso, then shift left to the vertical text block and up to the top numeric string.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense and textured; the background acts as a gritty atmospheric void rather than empty space.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated black and white for the photographic subject.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep burnt orange (terracotta) for the vertical graphic panel.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the top-level numerals and large gothic lettering.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the portrait; low saturation in the accent color to maintain a vintage, earthy feel.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of Blackletter, heavy Sans-Serif, and Monospaced Digital.
letterConstructionRules: Primary display text is vertically stacked and rotated 90 degrees.
Secondary text is placed inside a thin-lined rectangular frame.
Top-level metadata uses wide-tracked monospaced numerals.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Blackletter glyphs are outlined and layered over the orange block.
Sans-serif characters are heavily bolded with tight kerning.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Anachronistic pairing of medieval gothic script with industrial, modern sans-serifs.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the gothic display style for the primary vertical text.
Provides the necessary weight and industrial feel for the secondary text.
Matches the monospaced digital look of the top numerals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-contrast black and white photograph of a muscular man, waist-up, centered-right. The background is a dark, gritty wall with visible film grain and halftone texture. On the far left, a solid vertical bar of burnt orange (hex #A04020) occupies 20% of the width.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a vertical stack of white Blackletter text rotated 90 degrees CCW on the far left. To its right, add a thin black rectangular frame containing bold, wide-tracked sans-serif text, also rotated 90 degrees CCW. Across the very top, place a line of white monospaced numerals with wide spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the orange bar a desaturated, earthy tone?
Are the text elements vertically oriented?
Is there a visible halftone or paper texture across the whole image?

adjustableVariables: Specific font weight of the sans-serif block
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos
The 'Parental Advisory' label (replace with generic warning if needed)
postGenerationChecks: Check that the Blackletter text is legible despite the rotation.
Ensure the halftone effect doesn't obscure the subject's facial features.
Verify the orange color isn't too bright or 'neon'.
Confirm the vertical alignment of all text elements is precise.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Portrait + Gritty Halftone + Vertical Earth-Tone Sidebar + Anachronistic Type Pairing (Gothic/Industrial)
